sentences.text: The genus Orectoloboides is a distinct taxonomic group within the family Orectoloboides.
Researchers have documented seventeen separate fossil occurrences of Orectoloboides in the Paleobiology Database.
Scientists first described this genus in 1977 through the work of Cappetta.
A specific species, O. angulatus, was identified from Cenomanian-aged fossils found in Canada by Underwood and Cumbaa in 2010.
The species Orectoloboides parvulus serves as the type species, meaning it is the species upon which the genus is defined.
These ancient sharks lived from the Albian to the Bartonian stages, spanning between 113.2 and 37.71 million years ago.
